concepts.def: Multicultural society — over 25% of Germans have a Migrationshintergrund (migration background).
Largest minority group; descendants of Gastarbeiter who arrived from 1961 onwards.
Official statistical category covering people who themselves or at least one parent were born without German citizenship.
Disputed concept of a 'guiding culture' to which immigrants should adapt.
Weak, strong, mixed endings depending on article: 'die neue Heimat, ein neues Land'.
Discrimination — banned by the Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz (AGG) of 2006.
